name: Anna Jacobsen
office: City of Claremont, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Anna Jacobsen is an urban planner and the managing partner of CityWise, a public policy consulting firm she founded in 2020. She holds master's degrees in planning and public administration from USC. She says she has experience helping cities address housing, homelessness, and long-term planning. She founded Better Claremont Playgrounds and serves as board president of The Play Collective, the nonprofit it became.

sentences.text: Anna Jacobsen is an urban planner and the managing partner of CityWise, a public policy consulting firm she founded in 2020.
She holds master's degrees in planning and public administration from USC.
She says she has experience helping cities address housing, homelessness, and long-term planning.

items.text: At a study session on inclusionary housing, she says she encouraged the City Council to use housing in-lieu funds to help with housing stability. She says she advocated for Claremont’s speed-limit reductions and has spoken with residents about streets and intersections.
